cohort.description: Prespecified uniform calibration subset of a fixed PersonPath22 panel.
caveats: The certificate applies to the full fixed benchmark panel.
Coverage is over one prospectively drawn uniform subset of the frozen pool and fixed policies.
Counts within source groups and results across policies may be dependent.
Empirical active-source coverage and recovery utility have no lower confidence guarantee here.
The tool verifies artifact consistency. The operator must preserve prospective draw and policy-freeze timing.
Choose the risk test and policy family before calibration or allocate confidence across all tried tests.
cohort.scope: Fixed finite source pool only. The random complement is held out for descriptive evaluation.

selection_objective: Maximize observed correctly recovered gaps over the shared cohort.
risk_label_scope: Wrong among accepted reconnects counted as evaluable by the replay labeling protocol.

event_weighted_cap.enforcement: Replay gate counts accepted actions by source and stops at cap.
